## Helper Functions

```{r}
# helper function for loading and processing Patches scores
load_process_patches_scores <- function(file) {
  
  # read in df from file and fix column names
  df <- read_csv(
    file,
    col_names = TRUE,
    name_repair = "minimal",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  colnames(df)[1] = "gene_id"
  
  # remove _Patches from column names and
  # replace spaces in column names with underscores and
  # remove + signs
  df <- df %>%
    rename_with(~ sub("_Patches$", "", .x), ends_with("_Patches")) %>% 
    rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, " ", "_")) %>% 
    rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "\\+", ""))
  
  # add combinations of scores
  
  ## max absolute value for condition (treatment)
  df <- df %>% 
    mutate(
      sMAV = pmax(
        abs(stim_score),
        abs(ctrl_score)
      )
    )
  
  ## Euclidean norm for condition (treatment)
  df <- df %>% 
    mutate(
      sEN = sqrt(
        stim_score^2 +
          ctrl_score^2
      )
    )
  
  ## absolute difference for condition
  df <- df %>% 
    mutate(
      sAD = abs(stim_score - ctrl_score))
    
  if ("B_cells_score" %in% names(df)) {
    # cell type and condition scores available
    
    exclude_cols <- c("common_score", "stim_score", "ctrl_score")
    
    ## max absolute value for cell types
    df <- df %>% 
      mutate(
        tMAV = pmax(
          abs(B_cells_score),
          abs(CD14_Monocytes_score),
          abs(CD4_T_cells_score),
          abs(CD8_T_cells_score),
          abs(Dendritic_cells_score),
          abs(FCGR3A_Monocytes_score),
          abs(Megakaryocytes_score),
          abs(NK_cells_score)
        )
      )
    
    ## Euclidean norm for cell types
    df <- df %>% 
      mutate(
        tEN = sqrt(
          B_cells_score^2 +
            CD14_Monocytes_score^2 +
            CD4_T_cells_score^2 +
            CD8_T_cells_score^2 +
            Dendritic_cells_score^2 +
            FCGR3A_Monocytes_score^2 +
            Megakaryocytes_score^2 +
            NK_cells_score^2
        )
      )
    
    ## mean absolute difference for group
    df <- df %>% 
      mutate(
        tMAD = {
          # select all relevant columns
          score_cols <- grep("cells|cytes", names(df), value = TRUE)
          
          # get all unique pairs of columns
          pairs <- combn(score_cols, 2, simplify = FALSE)
          
          # compute all absolute pairwise differences
          diffs <- lapply(pairs, function(p) abs(df[[p[1]]] - df[[p[2]]]))
          
          # take rowMeans of those differences
          rowMeans(do.call(cbind, diffs), na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
    
  }
  
  return(df)
    
}

# helper function for loading and processing FSS scores
load_process_fss_scores <- function(files) {
  
  # select gene and score columns and combine all dfs in one list
  dfs <- lapply(files, function(file) {
    
    # read in df from file
    df <- readRDS(file)
    
    # rename score value column to score name
    if (nrow(df) > length(unique(df$gene_id))) {
      # df contains both tPVE and sPVE scores
      
      df <- df %>% 
        pivot_wider(names_from = sco, values_from = sco_val)
      cols_to_keep <- c("gene_id", "tPVE", "sPVE")
      
    } else {
      # df contains a single score (all but tPVE + sPVE)
      
      new_colname <- df$sco[1]
      df <- df %>% 
        rename(!!new_colname := sco_val)
      cols_to_keep <- c("gene_id", new_colname)
      
    }
    
    # select gene and score columns
    df <- df %>% 
      select(all_of(cols_to_keep))
    
    # return df
    return(df)
    
  })
  
  # combine all dfs in one df
  df_combined <- as_tibble(reduce(
    dfs, 
    ~ inner_join(.x, .y, by = "gene_id")
  ))
  
  # return combined df
  return(df_combined)
  
}
```



## Load and Process Patches Scores

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  path = "../../data/kang/02-sco/",
  pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE,
)

patches_scores <- lapply(files, load_process_patches_scores)
names(patches_scores) <- sub("_loadings.csv", "", basename(files))
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(

  full.names = TRUE
)

fss_scores <- load_process_fss_scores(files)
```

```{r}
head(fss_scores)
```



## Combine and Transform Scores

```{r}
# combine Patches and FSS scores in one df for each Patches workflow
# and add z-transformed scores
# and add ranks
all_scores <- lapply(patches_scores, function(df) {
  
  new_df <- cbind.data.frame(
    df,
    fss_scores %>% 
      select(!gene_id)
  )
  
  # add z-transformed scores and ranks
  if ("common_score_z" %in% colnames(df)) {
    # z-transformations already exist, skip df
    return(new_df)
  }
  
  new_df <- new_df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        .cols = -gene_id,
        .fns = list(
          z = ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
          rank = ~ rank(-.x, ties.method = "first")
        ),
        .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
      )
    )
  
  return(new_df)
  
})

lapply(all_scores, head)
```



## Export Scores

```{r}
saveRDS(patches_scores, file = "../../data/kang/02-sco/patches_scores.rds")
saveRDS(fss_scores, file = "../../data/kang/02-sco/fss_scores.rds")
saveRDS(all_scores, file = "../../data/kang/02-sco/all_scores.rds")
```



## Compare Scores

### Correlation Between Scores

```{r}
# create correlation plots
cor_plots_rank <- lapply(all_scores, function(df) {
  
  # select z-transformed scores
  df_rank <- df %>% 
    select(ends_with("_rank"))
  
  # calculate pairwise Spearman rank correlations
  cor_mat <- cor(
    df_rank,
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
    method = "spearman"
  )
  
  # plot correlations as a heat map
  cor_long <- melt(cor_mat)
  ggplot(data = cor_long, mapping = aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "C",
      direction = 1,
      limits = c(-1, 1)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11)
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Correlation")
  
})

cor_plots_rank
```

```{r}
# combine individual plots
subtitles <- c(
  "Cell Types & Conditions",
  "Conditions"
)
cor_plots_rank <- Map(function(p, sub) p + ggtitle(sub), cor_plots_rank, subtitles)

cor_plots_rank <- lapply(cor_plots_rank, function(p) {
  p + theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18)
  )
})

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(cor_plots_rank, ncol = 1, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Spearman Correlation of Ranked Scores",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(b = 30),
        size = 20,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
  )

# save and show combined plot
ggsave("sco_cor_rank.png", combined_plot, path = "../../outs/kang/",
       width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)
combined_plot
```

### Overlap of top-n genes (Jaccard Index)

```{r}
# function to compute the top-n genes for a given rank
get_top_n_genes <- function(df, rank, n) {
  top_genes <- (df %>% 
    arrange(.data[[rank]]) %>% 
    slice_head(n = n))$gene_id
  
  return(top_genes)
}

# function to compute Jaccard index for top n genes
compute_jaccard <- function(df, rank1, rank2, n) {
  top1 <- get_top_n_genes(df, rank1, n)
  top2 <- get_top_n_genes(df, rank2, n)
  length(intersect(top1, top2)) / length(union(top1, top2))
}

# function to compute Jaccard matrix for all provided ranks
compute_jaccard_matrix <- function(df, n) {
  
  rank_cols <- grep("_rank$", colnames(df), value = TRUE)
  m <- length(rank_cols)
  
  jmat <- matrix(NA, nrow = m, ncol = m, dimnames = list(rank_cols, rank_cols))
  
  for (i in seq_along(rank_cols)) {
    for (j in seq_along(rank_cols)) {
      jmat[i, j] <- compute_jaccard(df, rank_cols[i], rank_cols[j], n)
    }
  }
  
  return(jmat)
  
}
```

```{r}
# plot Jaccard indices as heat maps
j_plots <- lapply(all_scores, function(df) {
  
  j_mat <- compute_jaccard_matrix(df, 100)
  
  j_long <- melt(j_mat)
  ggplot(data = j_long, mapping = aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "C",
      direction = 1,
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11)
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "Jaccard\nIndex")
  
})

j_plots
```
